subject: Money
title: Venezuela's Crisis
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Venezuela's Crisis.

hook.text: In 2019, a cup of coffee in Caracas cost 1 million bolivars. The next week, it cost 1.5 million.

buildup.text: Venezuela sits on the world's largest oil reserves. When oil prices crashed in 2014, revenue collapsed.

discovery.text: The government printed money to fund social programs. Inflation hit 1.7 million percent in 2018.

twist.text: 3.4 million Venezuelans fled the country by 2019. Hyperinflation caused a refugee crisis.

climax.text: Price controls made shortages worse. Stores emptied. A country rich in oil couldn't feed its people.

punchline.text: Oil wealth means nothing without monetary discipline.

quiz.question: What triggered Venezuela's hyperinflation?
options: Oil price collapse and money printing
